opportunities.name: GitHub developer lead research and hiring email
opportunities.description: Look up the GitHub user {username}, note their follower count, top repo (stars, language) and latest post, then draft an email to {recipient} with the subject 'Lead for {role}: {username}' that summarizes the profile.
steps: Open GitHub and click 'Search or jump to'
Type {username} and press Enter
Click the 'Users' results filter
Open the matching user's profile
Note the follower count and latest blog post
Open the top pinned repo and note its stars and language
Open the mail compose form
Set To = {recipient}
Set Subject = 'Lead for {role}: {username}'
Set Body = '{username}: {followers} followers, top repo {repo} ({stars} stars, {language}), latest post: {post}.'
Send or save the draft

instances.values: username=karpathy, role=ML Research Engineer, recipient=hiring@example.com, repo=nanoGPT

opportunities.name: Nearest-place walking route plus neighborhood summary note
opportunities.description: Find the nearest {place_type} to {address} on OpenStreetMap, get the walking distance and time, look up {neighborhood} on Wikipedia, and save a note that combines both.
steps: In the OpenStreetMap search box, search '{place_type} near {address}'
Open the closest result
Click 'Find directions between two points' and choose Foot
Set From = {address} and To = the chosen place, then press Enter
Note the distance and walking time
Search Wikipedia for {neighborhood} and note its one-line description
Create a new note: '{address}: nearest {place_type} {place}, {distance}, {time} walk. {neighborhood}: {summary}'

instances.values: address=350 5th Ave, New York; place_type=library; result=96th Street Library; neighborhood=Midtown Manhattan
query=coffee near Union Square, followed by a Wikipedia search (incomplete)

opportunities.name: Person bio and company homepage archive snapshot note
opportunities.description: Look up {person} on Wikipedia, view {company_domain} on the Wayback Machine for {year}, and save a note with the person's key facts and the archived homepage headline.
steps: Search Wikipedia for {person} and note the birth date and role
Open the Wayback Machine and enter {company_domain}
Select the year {year} and open a snapshot
Note the headline on the homepage
Create a new note: '{person}: born {date}, {role}. {company_domain} in {year}: {headline}'
